annotations.text: This Software Bill-of-Materials (SBOM) including GitHub Actions document was created on Friday, June 5, 2026 with cdxgen. The data was captured during the build lifecycle phase. The document describes an application named 'github.com/pardnchiu/go-jwt'. This SBOM contains 4 GitHub Action references across 1 workflow(s) and 1 job(s). The workflows are: Test. Version pinning breakdown: 4 tag-pinned. 3 official action(s) are from trusted sources. Security strengths: 4 action(s) are pinned to version tags and 3 action(s) are official GitHub Actions from github.com org. Overall, the workflow demonstrates good version pinning practices. 2 package type(s) and 18 purl namespaces are described in the document under components.
